Job Purpose

Responsible for analyzing operational, network, and service performance data to support decision-making, improve operational efficiency, identify trends, and drive service quality improvements across the telecommunications business.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain operational and network performance dashboards and reports.
• Analyse network, service, and customer data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Monitor and report key operational KPIs and business metrics.
• Perform root cause analysis for service degradation and operational issues.
• Support capacity planning, forecasting, and performance optimization initiatives.
• Collaborate with Network, IT, Digital, and Business teams to deliver data-driven insights.
• Automate reporting and data analysis processes to improve efficiency.
• Ensure data quality, accuracy, and governance compliance.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Engineering, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or telecom operations analytics.
• Experience working with large datasets in a telecommunications environment preferred.

Technical Requirements

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
• Experience with Python, R, or other analytics programming languages.
• Knowledge of data warehousing, ETL processes, and database management.
• Understanding of telecom KPIs, network performance metrics, and customer experience analytics.
• Familiarity with big data platforms (Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.) is an advantage.

Preferred Certifications

• Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst
• Tableau Certified Professional
• Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
• Databricks Data Engineer/Analyst
• ITIL Foundation

Key Competencies

• Strong business and operational acumen.
• Data storytelling and presentation skills.
• Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
• Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
• Continuous improvement and automation mindset.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced telecommunications environment.

Employment Status:

Permanent (P)

Carry out daily Parent Stock farm activities according to work instructions and SOPs.
Perform routine tasks such as feeding, egg collection, cleaning, and flock care.
Observe and report flock conditions, mortality, and operational abnormalities to the supervisor.
Follow biosecurity, animal welfare, safety, and hygiene requirements at all times.
Maintain cleanliness of facilities, equipment, and work areas.
Record daily operational data accurately as instructed.
Support team activities to ensure smooth and efficient farm operations.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
